prompt:
Use case: illustration-story / retro school panorama revision.
USER DIRECTION: MORE PEOPLE, MUCH FARTHER CAMERA, RETRO feeling, deeply FAMILIAR and CUTE. Add meaningful lovingly observed school-life DETAILS that make people feel "I remember this", not generic ornament. 
Reference1 = previous campus panorama to recompose. Reference2 = APPROVED HUMAN-SHAPED mascot roster, preserve those exact faces/shapes/roles. Reference3 = original website school scene for expansive scale and density.
Create a substantially NEW composition, not a minor variation of reference1. One high-resolution 5:2 horizontal panorama, ideally 3840x1536. FOURTY (about 38-44) small HUMAN-SHAPED mascot pupils distributed in many distinct believable school activities, no animals, no realistic humans. Camera significantly FARTHER back and a little more elevated, a nostalgic complete-school bird's-eye / school picture-map view with visible grounds stretching behind and between groups. Characters no taller than 5-7% of entire canvas height, the four primary mascots at most 8-9%. In the previous picture people were still too large. Make a complete lively SCHOOL WORLD, not four big character vignettes in a row. Stagger groups at different depths, connected by paths. All important characters and props entirely inside canvas.
STYLE: vintage Japanese school picture-book / printed educational wall-map charm from late Showa / early Heisei school life. Drawn by a skilled human illustrator, gently irregular warm dark-brown ink contours, charming rounded simple forms, muted but clear printed colors, slightly creamy paper base, very subtle fine print grain only. Feel timeless, nostalgic and welcoming, NOT dirty distressed, sepia, pixel art, low-resolution, western 1950s diner, horror or over-saturated game art. Clear readable shapes with well-designed details. No shiny 3D, smooth digital gradients, glossy highlights, cinematic lighting, AI anime faces. Keep the approved approximately two-head-tall humanoid design: big peach round faces, black simple eyes, small smiles, coral cheeks, short dark graphic hair, short arms and legs, small cream shoes. People must be physically coherent and expressive, not duplicated identical dolls. Dark ink linework thinner for background, stronger around tiny people. NO tiny illegible text.
PALETTE: sun-faded robin's-egg sky, creamy warm paper and sand, bottle green and sage, brick vermilion, dusty school blue, mustard yellow. Green / orange / blue / yellow roles retained. Enough contrast to read tiny faces, no washed out scene.

SPATIAL LAYOUT:
Upper 22-27% quiet robin's-egg blue sky, few small hand-drawn cream clouds, empty central sky for website's own heading. Trees and buildings below that. Broad connected school campus occupying remaining image, gentle moderately elevated viewpoint, small architectural detail rewards closer viewing. Cream SCHOOLHOUSE right-of-center with dusty blue roof, central round CLOCK, repeating windows, small entrance shoe-cubby shapes visible in doorway, nearby gym to left, modest front gate far left, low simple fence. Clock, flowerbeds, rounded trees, schoolyard track, flag poles make familiar Japanese school.
Schoolyard large and sprawling with paths, planted beds and an oval track. Deliberate negative space between clusters even with forty pupils. Front edge low flowerbed and a few low shrubs, no enormous foreground leaves.

FOUR PRIMARY ACTIVITY ZONES, connected but with multiple small scenes:
LEFT CLASSROOM / 学級活動 (~8 mascots): small open-front classroom alcove with wooden desks in an open horseshoe, dark green blackboard with 3-5 colored rectangular discussion cards, chalk eraser resting on tray, unlettered classroom wall clock. Green 学活くん (cream vertical placket and little note card) facilitating classmates: one raises hand, one writes meeting notes, two turn to each other listening, two seated looking attentively. Faces varied and visible, full bodies or naturally occluded by desks, no disconnected torsos. Chairs and backpacks neatly beside desks.
CENTER-LEFT SPORTS / 学校行事 (~10 mascots): white chalk oval track with 3 runners including unmistakable baton handoff, orange 行人 with white headband and yellow flag cheering near track, 3 cheering classmates with red/white caps at a safe side line, 2 working together carrying a small basket of red/white beanbags, one recording results at a tiny low table. Red entry arch and bunting, small white event tent with rolled-up flap behind. Distinct little bent-knee action poses, all at same small distant scale.
CENTER-RIGHT STUDENT COUNCIL / 児童会活動 (~9 mascots): blue 児童会ちゃん with two HUMAN side hair buns, yellow sash and mic on small low wooden stage, one co-host with agenda board, 5 classmates sitting on stools or benches facing them at angles with faces visible, 2 classmates cooperatively pin a poster to a noticeboard nearby. Poster uses 3 simple colored shapes, NO text. Focus on active child leadership and shared participation, not military line of backs.
RIGHT CLUBS / クラブ活動 (~9 mascots): yellow クラブマン with blue headband, white star outlined dark on chest, short brick-red cape. Two classmates painting at small easels, 2 building a wood toy plane at worktable, 2 practicing a little drum and tambourine, 2 kneeling to plant flowers in a small raised bed. Simple organized familiar tools, brush jar and paint palette with only a few colors. No dangerous tools or chemicals.
EXTRA QUIET SCHOOL-LIFE DETAILS (~4 mascots spread through middle background): two watering marigolds with a green watering can; one tidies fallen leaves with broom; one carries a stack of classroom notebooks toward school. Small faucet/washing area near garden, buckets neatly arranged, a forgotten red-white cap on a bench, simple chalk hopscotch squares off the running track. These details should feel observed, understated, not a random scavenger-hunt prop dump.

COMPOSITION GUARDRAILS:
TOTAL around 40 small humanoid people spread across depth and width. Faces and gestures remain identifiable on closer viewing, exactly approved roster language. Four primary mascots discernible by their established props/colors, NOT giants. Small scenes naturally belong in one school, not a symmetrical dashboard or four panels. Warm nostalgic human connection, helping, listening, playing and making things. More fine detail in objects and interactions, NOT texture overload. Every limb coherent; seated pupils visibly seated on furniture, no bodies emerging from soil. No animals, commercial mascots, game franchises, coins, magic objects, text, titles, UI elements, watermarks.
